title.zh: 已摧毁采矿无人机基地

excerpt.zh: 我们摧毁了采矿无人机基地，并成功取回了其中储存的大部分经过加工的矿产和珍贵的合金。
excerpt.en: We have destroyed the Mining Drone base, and managed to recover most of its stores of processed minerals and precious alloys.
